name: Rolling, Rolling, Tumbling Along
source:
"I can't climb up the stairs."

Tasuku Yamada, a high school student who experiences strange dreams and struggles with his masculinity, goes to the school festival with his new girlfriend and her other friend. The festival is nowhere near as fun as it sounds. Is everything a dream... or reality? And who is the mysterious girl that he somehow knows, but can't remember how...?

[From [url=https://ashscratchsoft.itch.io/tumbling]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我爬不上楼梯。”

饱受怪梦困扰、对自身男子气概深感迷茫的高中生山田佑，与新交往的女友及她的另一位朋友一同前往学园祭。然而这场学园祭远没有听上去那样欢乐。眼前的一切究竟是梦境……还是现实？而那个他明明似曾相识、却怎么也想不起究竟在哪里见过的神秘少女，又到底是谁……？

[摘自[url=https://ashscratchsoft.itch.io/tumbling]itch.io[/url]]
